roll.prompt: A biped swordsman performs one compact forward somersault dodge roll, then recovers to a balanced standing guard. Keep the sword hand closed. One action only, no walking, no camera motion.

dodgeLeft.prompt: A biped swordsman performs one quick short sidestep dodge to the character's left while facing forward, then returns to a stable standing guard. One action only, no turning, no camera motion.

dodgeRight.prompt: A biped swordsman performs one quick short sidestep dodge to the character's right while facing forward, then returns to a stable standing guard. One action only, no turning, no camera motion.

dodgeBack.prompt: A biped swordsman performs one short backward dodge step while facing forward, then recovers to a stable standing guard. One action only, no turning, no camera motion.

land.prompt: A biped swordsman lands from a small jump, bends the knees to absorb impact, then returns to a relaxed standing guard. One landing only, no takeoff, no horizontal travel, no camera motion.
